description: Network access for one battery by DUID over a date window: the same exposure shares as get_network_access, a 12-block (2-hour, market time) time-of-day profile for discharge and charge limits, the five constraints that bound most often with AEMO's descriptions (these name the lines and outages involved), commissioning_days, and the current financial year's loss factors with their effect on energy revenue versus an MLF of 1.0. Exposure, not lost revenue. A high all-interval share with a low top-price share means the limits fall in low-price hours (often midday). Minimum window 30 days (shorter is widened); data from July 2024.

date_from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Ranges under 30 days are widened to the last 30 days ending date_to.

duid.description: Battery DUID, e.g. KESSB1. Use list_bess_units to find it from a station name.

name: get_battery_network_access
title: Battery network access (binding constraints)
